styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.MAKSOE: a sturdy middle-aged temple worker with a weathered kind face, soot on his cheeks and hands, in coarse gray hemp work clothes and straw sandals
characters.HYEUN: a very old master monk with a long white beard in a plain gray monk robe
characters.SANGJWA: a middle-aged head monk with a shaved head in a gray monk robe
characters.OFFICER: a stern middle-aged official with a short beard in a dark blue robe and black gat

scenes.S01: Close-up before dawn at a Korean temple kitchen furnace: the soot-blackened hands of a man feeding pine branches into a glowing fire, orange firelight on his knuckles. No faces, nothing written.
scenes.S02: [WEB] Scene in a Korean temple courtyard at dawn, two clear roles: 1. CENTER, standing in soot-stained work clothes with a bundle of firewood at his feet: MAKSOE. 2. AROUND HIM, several monks in gray robes bowing deeply toward him. Old pine trees and a tiled temple hall behind.
scenes.S05: A Korean mountain temple at dawn: tiled roofs among pine trees, morning mist in the valley, a stone staircase leading up, a small bell pavilion. No people.
scenes.S06: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE crouching in front of a big stone furnace in a temple kitchen, pushing firewood into the fire, his face and hands smudged with soot, steam rising from a huge iron pot.
scenes.S07: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE climbing a snowy mountain path with a huge load of firewood on an A-frame carrier on his back, breath white in the cold, bare trees around him.
scenes.S08: A Korean temple courtyard: three young monks in gray robes walking past and glancing sideways with faint smirks at MAKSOE, who stands aside holding a water bucket with his head lowered.
scenes.S09: [SIL] Sunset over a mountain temple, black silhouettes of tiled roofs and pine trees, one thin line of smoke rising from the kitchen chimney into gold and orange clouds.
scenes.S10: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE standing in a dim temple kitchen doorway, looking out toward the lit main hall in the evening, his hands black with soot, a faint longing on his face.
scenes.S11: Exactly two people: an old master monk with a white beard in a gray robe sitting on a low stool beside MAKSOE in front of the kitchen furnace at night, both looking into the fire, warm orange light on their faces.
scenes.S12: Exactly two people: MAKSOE holding his rough soot-stained hands toward the fire while speaking, and the old master monk listening with a warm nod, firelight between them.
scenes.S14: Exactly two people: the old master monk placing a small wooden moktak in MAKSOE's soot-blackened hands, MAKSOE looking down at it in surprise, in a dim temple kitchen.
scenes.S15: Close-up in a dim temple kitchen: a growing stack of small hand-carved wooden blocks in a corner behind the furnace, each with a simple scratched mark, soft firelight. No people, no letters.
scenes.S16: Several officials in dark robes and black gat standing sternly in a temple courtyard with a scroll in hand, monks gathered before them looking worried, tiled temple hall behind.
scenes.S17: Monks in gray robes sitting in rows inside a dim temple hall with grim faces, one elder speaking, candlelight on the wooden floor.
scenes.S18: [SIL] Sunset over a mountain temple with its gate closed, black silhouettes of a few figures walking down the stone stairs away from it, layered gray and gold clouds.
scenes.S19: An old master monk lying on a thin mat in a small temple room, pale and weak, two young monks kneeling beside him, an oil lamp on the floor.
scenes.S20: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE sitting alone on the wooden veranda outside a closed paper door at night, hands on his knees, snow on the railing, a lantern beside him.
scenes.S22: An old master monk propped up on a mat, holding a brush over a sheet of paper with a trembling hand, a young monk holding the ink stone, lamplight in a small room. Nothing written on the paper.
scenes.S23: [SIL] Snowy night over a mountain temple, black silhouettes of roofs and pines, one paper window glowing warm yellow, a thin line of smoke from the chimney.
scenes.S24: Monks and officials gathered in a temple hall, a middle-aged head monk carefully opening a sealed envelope, everyone leaning in, daylight through paper windows.
scenes.S25: Only one person in the picture: a middle-aged head monk in gray robes standing and reading a sheet of paper, his eyes wide and his mouth slightly open in shock. Plain background, no letters visible.
scenes.S26: Monks and officials in a temple hall reacting in surprise, several talking to each other, one official frowning at the paper, daylight.
scenes.S27: [WEB] Scene inside a temple kitchen: monks and officials crowding in the doorway, staring at a whole wall stacked from floor to ceiling with thousands of small hand-carved wooden blocks. MAKSOE stands quietly beside the furnace in soot-stained clothes.
scenes.S28: Close-up of a monk's hands holding a few small wooden blocks, each covered with simple scratched tally marks, more blocks stacked behind. No letters anywhere.
scenes.S30: A middle-aged head monk reading from a sheet of paper in a temple hall, monks around him lowering their heads, some with tears, daylight through paper windows.
scenes.S31: Exactly two people: an official in a dark robe holding up one small tally-marked wooden block and studying it closely, MAKSOE standing quietly behind him in soot-stained clothes. Temple kitchen background.
scenes.S32: [WEB] Scene in a temple courtyard in the morning: MAKSOE standing awkwardly in soot-stained work clothes with a bundle of firewood at his feet, and a dozen monks in gray robes bowing deeply to him in two rows. Pine trees and tiled hall behind.
scenes.S34: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE back at the kitchen furnace, feeding firewood into the fire with a calm face, the small moktak hanging on the wall beside him.
scenes.S35: A temple kitchen: MAKSOE showing two young monks in gray robes how to stack firewood in the furnace, all three crouching, warm firelight, steam from a big iron pot.
scenes.S36: Only one person in the picture: MAKSOE sitting on the kitchen doorstep at dusk holding a small wooden moktak in both hands, eyes closed with a peaceful face, warm light behind him.
scenes.S37: [SIL] Full moon over a mountain temple at night, black silhouettes of tiled roofs and pines, one thin line of smoke rising from the kitchen chimney, layered silver clouds and a gold band.
